# Release signing public keys -- THE single source of truth.
#
# One `<key_id> <minisign public key base64>` pair per line (the base64 line
# of minisign.pub); '#' lines and blank lines are ignored. BOTH consumers
# read this exact file, so they can never drift:
#   - src/update.rs embeds it at compile time (include_str!) and parses it
#     into HIGGS_UPDATE_PUBKEYS -- the pins every shipped binary verifies
#     against;
#   - the release workflow reads it to refuse signing with any key not
#     listed here.
# Unit tests validate that every line parses and key_ids are unique.
#
# Empty today (no key minted yet): releases are blocked until the one-time
# pinning step -- see src/update.rs HIGGS_UPDATE_PUBKEYS for the procedure.
# Example (after minting):
#   higgs-release-1 RWTAAAA...base64 of minisign.pub...
higgs-release-1 RWQF20Rd+9jIND7YdCJsl3btwZKBAvF1EzRyHWiR8MH7C0JHhRSRdzSC
